place_address: Near Galaxy Hospital, PD Nagar, Nirala Nagar, Unnao, Uttar Pradesh 209801

reviews.text: The Kurkure momos here are hands down the crunchiest in all of Unnao! The ₹130 pizza + burger combo is unbeatable value. Perfect spot to chill with friends.
Dil Ka Margherita and Spicy Paneer Pizza are absolute fire! The cheese pull is real and toppings are super fresh. Love the neon vibe and quick service.
Finally a modern cafe in PD Nagar with top-tier aesthetics and actually delicious Chinese! Hakka noodles with honey chilli potato is our weekend ritual.
Celebrated our friend's birthday in their private neon lounge! The staff decorated everything beautifully, and the super combos made party ordering so affordable.
